description: This Java interface defines a service for reading share account charge data within the Fineract platform. It declares a method to retrieve account charges based on account ID and status.

classes.name: ShareAccountChargeReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface for retrieving share account charge data in the Fineract system

methods.name: retrieveAccountCharges
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of ShareAccountChargeData objects for a given account ID and optional status filter
